items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: met Elaine, which was the major factor in my being as successful as I've been up to this point... Elaine was down in the city and would come up on weekends and she fell in love with the place up here and we decided to settle here

ctx.x: He said write me an album like you did on those altos, I said sure Zoot, I'll be glad to, set it up. Yeah, well, I have to get in touch with Norman Granz to set it up. I said you do that and get back to me, I'll be happy to do it. Then I hung up and I told Elaine he's not going to call back, he's just very mellow tonight and that's what came out.
